Fisher College offers a Master of Business Administration degree in Strategic Leadership.

The MBA program has been designed to prepare students for increased responsibility through the development, practice, and application of knowledge and skills used by highly successful business professionals today — 96% of students employed or in an advanced degree program within a year of graduation.

Companies where MBA students have been employed:

  • KPMG
  • WalkWater Technologies
  • Benefit Cosmetics
  • Robert Half International
  • Santander Bank
